Ostrava

Friday 27 November 2026

The Czech city of Ostrava opens the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup as a brand-new addition to the calendar. On Friday 27 November, the riders will compete for the first time at the former mining site. The evening races mark a unique start to the season. Who will claim the first World Cup victory?

Tickets

Would you like to be there in Ostrava on Friday 27 November? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

Online:

Adults: 550 CZK

Students, seniors and people with disabilities: 350 CZK

Children under 12 years old can enter for free and do not need to order a ticket.

How to get there?

Address

Dolní oblast Vítkovice, Vítkovice 3004, 703 00 Ostrava

 

By public transport

Take tram 3, 7 or 17 and get off at "Bělský les". It takes 18 minutes from the main station. From the tram stop walk along the right-hand side towards the forest. After 200 metres you'll reach the main pedestrian entrance, marked with banners and signage. The walk takes about 5 minutes and is well lit.

 

By car

Take exit D1 Ostrava-jih, then continue along Plzeňská street. There's free parking around the venue. Main P1 lot is on Plzeňská right next to the south entrance (600 spaces). When full, navigation will redirect you to P2 at OC Avion (shuttle every 10 minutes). We recommend arriving before 17:00 or using public transport.
